en: Proverbs 21

p.src: 1  The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

en: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
u.src: 1  The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

p.src: 2  Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
u.src: 2  Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

p.src: 3  To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

ja: うことは、 ささげ物よりも
en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
u.src: 3  To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

p.src: 4  A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

en: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
u.src: 4  A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

p.src: 5  The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

ja: は皆、必ず貧しさに陥る。
en: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
u.src: 5  The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

p.src: 6  Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

ja: は、 死を求める者の、
en: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
u.src: 6  Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

p.src: 7  The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

en: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
u.src: 7  The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

p.src: 8  The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

ja: がっているが、 潔白な者の
en: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
u.src: 8  The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

p.src: 9  It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
u.src: 9  It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

p.src: 10  The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

en: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
u.src: 10  The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

p.src: 11  When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

en: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
u.src: 11  When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

p.src: 12  The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

en: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
u.src: 12  The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

p.src: 13  Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

en: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
u.src: 13  Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

p.src: 14  A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

ja: りを静め、 衣の内に
en: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
u.src: 14  A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

p.src: 15  It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

en: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
u.src: 15  It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

p.src: 16  The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

en: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
u.src: 16  The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

p.src: 17  He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

en: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
u.src: 17  He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

p.src: 18  The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
u.src: 18  The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

p.src: 19  It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
u.src: 19  It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

p.src: 20  There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

en: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
u.src: 20  There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

p.src: 21  He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

en: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
u.src: 21  He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

p.src: 22  A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

en: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
u.src: 22  A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

p.src: 23  Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

en: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
u.src: 23  Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

p.src: 24  The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

en: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
u.src: 24  The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

p.src: 25  The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

en: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
u.src: 25  The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

p.src: 26  There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

ja: 欲しがるが、 義人は
en: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
u.src: 26  There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

p.src: 27  The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

ja: い思いをもってささげるなら、なおさらである。
en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
u.src: 27  The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

p.src: 28  A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

en: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
u.src: 28  A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

p.src: 29  A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

en: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
u.src: 29  A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

p.src: 30  There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
u.src: 30  There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

p.src: 31  The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

en: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
u.src: 31  The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
